notes.title: UPDATE: Mac'os Support live test
notes.notes:
What's new?

- We are happy to announce we have built version for Mac'os last time with success we introduce Linux version. All systems are compatible with each other. If you have Windows and your friend has Linux it's not a problem at all! You can still play together!
